## Showcase submission

Folder: `showcase/`

- [ ] The artwork is my own original work and I have the right to share it.
- [ ] It holds no logos, brand names, characters or other trademarks that are not mine.
- [ ] It is suitable for everyone.
- [ ] The folder holds only `artwork.cut`, `info.json` and `preview.webp` or `preview.png`.
- [ ] `artwork.cut` opens in Scissor, keeps its images embedded and is at most 10 MB.
- [ ] The preview shows the artwork, is at most 1600 px on its long side and is under 1 MB.
- [ ] `info.json` names the licence I chose (`CC-BY-4.0` or `CC0-1.0`), and I share the artwork, its preview and its description under it.
- [ ] Scissor may show the artwork in the app and on scissor.studio, crediting the name in `info.json`.
